title: Continuation procedure
summary: Continue ooRexx ML from v0.1-dev11 preserving historical-object execution, feasibility-before-Pareto, close-neighbour/pattern/temporal hashing and contextual wobbly-fit distance/reassignment semantics.
authority: Executable source/tests and supplied upstream API artifacts are authoritative; this sphere preserves architecture and continuity.
invariants: Do not replace driveable objects with disposable fit/predict wrappers.
Do not fork Maths, Foreign Runtime, Audio tensor semantics or Journal Pointed State.
Keep executable package and Gopher continuity sphere separate.
procedure: Load this dev10 sphere and verify executable dev10 qualification first.
Preserve deterministic RNG, transactional rollback and final-population scoring for scalar, Pareto and constrained-Pareto GA consumers.
Keep hard feasibility separate from objective tradeoffs; infeasible candidates may remain evidence/search hints but never frontier answers.
Keep Storage Fabric authoritative for workspace safety and durable completion; ML exports only value-only checkpoint/frontier identity.
Preserve dev7 conventional technique semantics and dev8 close-neighbour semantics including exact-oracle recall qualification.
Preserve dev9 polar pattern semantics: minimum-centred normalization, angular resampling, explicit invariance policy and largest-difference-first radius/slope/curvature ordering.
Preserve dev10 temporal semantics: time is cylinder height, temporal paths are open in time, multichannel events remain vector-valued, and bearing/elevation/turn evidence is significance ordered.
Do not erase local timing fluctuation merely because global time-scale invariance is enabled.

Preserve dev11 wobbly-fit semantics: wobble is model-relative, exclusion is diagnostic, minimal restoring sets define distance-to-fit, normative occurrence is distributional, and reassignment is explicit.
Next combine dev8 bounded close-neighbour candidate generation with exact dev10 temporal-pattern reranking, then add staggered angular/time covers and direct Layered Audio/Camera adapters.
Continue ROC/AUC, multiclass metrics, SVM/ensembles/stronger clustering and distributed Queue Fabric evaluation without moving semantic authority out of the ML experiment.
